scene: Inside the warm tea house, aromatic steam curls.
picture: A flat side view inside a floating crimson tea house. On the far left, a robotic tea-brewer tends steaming copper kettles behind a counter. An elderly East Asian man in a blue flat cap, orange cardigan, holding a wooden cane stands left of centre. Centre sits a low table with a checkered board. A spiral staircase rises far right.
shown: A robotic barista with steam pipes whistling at the tea counter on the far left.
A checkered board sitting untouched on a low wooden table in the centre.
A narrow wooden spiral staircase leading upward at the far right.

variants.scene: A friendly brass automaton whistles steam beside rows of glowing lanterns.
Lantern light warms the canal house as kettles bubble by the dock.
Warm tea aromas drift while you wonder if {quest} might be nearby.
